cases.description: When a new PropertiesValidator instance is created, getSchemas() should return the internal map which is initially empty.

group: Schemas map after adding entries via reflection

cases.expected: Map contains the added entry with key "user" and the corresponding JsonSchema instance
cases.description: Using reflection, insert a mock JsonSchema object into the private `schemas` field. getSchemas() must return a map that reflects this entry, proving the getter returns the actual internal map.

cases.expected: Modifying the map returned by getSchemas() (e.g., put a new entry) also changes the internal state of the validator
cases.description: Obtain the map via getSchemas(), add a new entry directly to this map, and then call getSchemas() again. The second call should show the newly added entry, confirming that the getter does not return a defensive copy.

cases.expected: Concurrent modifications to the map returned by getSchemas() are reflected without throwing ConcurrentModificationException during read
cases.description: Create two threads: one repeatedly adds entries to the map obtained from getSchemas(), the other repeatedly reads the map size. The test verifies that no unexpected exceptions are thrown and that the size observed is consistent with the number of insertions, demonstrating that getSchemas() returns the live map.

cases.expected: Two consecutive calls to getSchemas() return the exact same Map instance (reference equality)
cases.description: Verify that the getter does not create a new map each time but returns the internal live map instance.

cases.expected: The iteration order of the map matches the order in which entries were added (e.g., keys "a", "b", "c" appear in that sequence)
cases.description: Add several entries to the map returned by getSchemas() in a known order and then iterate over keySet() to confirm that LinkedHashMap preserves insertion order.

group: Removal of entries via returned map

cases.expected: After removing a key from the map obtained from getSchemas(), the internal map no longer contains that key and its size decreases accordingly
cases.description: Insert a mock JsonSchema under key "temp", call getSchemas().remove("temp"), then verify that a subsequent call to getSchemas() reports the key absent.

cases.expected: Putting a null key with a JsonSchema value into the map returned by getSchemas() succeeds and the map reports containsKey(null) == true
cases.description: LinkedHashMap permits a single null key; this test ensures that getSchemas() exposes that behavior and does not guard against null keys.

cases.expected: Inserting a second JsonSchema under an existing key replaces the previous value; the map size remains unchanged and getSchemas().get(key) returns the new instance
cases.description: Add an entry with key "duplicate", then add another entry with the same key but a different mock JsonSchema. Verify that the map size stays the same and the value is the latest one.
